title: Chintamani Library v2.3.1 (Build 35) — Universal Architecture & Branch-Aware Portal
releaseNotes: Fixed Installation Error: Replaced split architecture with full Universal APK containing complete native libraries for all architectures (resolves 'App not installed as package appears to be invalid')
Fixed Update Loop: App no longer repeatedly shows 'Update Available' after installing an update — native versionCode (Build 35) is read directly from Android PackageManager
Stacked Dialog Fix: Only one update dialog can appear per session — SplashScreen and DashboardScreen can no longer race and show duplicate prompts
Session Guard: Update check runs exactly once per cold launch regardless of which screen triggers it
Branch-Aware Universal QR Portal: Mehdawal and Khalilabad now operate as completely separate datasets from one global branch switcher
Real Seat Counts: Khalilabad = 72 single-hall seats (K01–K72), Mehdawal = 65 single-hall seats (M01–M65)
Anti-Cross-Branch Enforcement: Backend blocks cross-branch seat assignments and attendance check-ins with a clear error message
